mapper.sql: id, operational_module_type_enum, notification_type_enum, trigger_mode_type_enum, push_date, is_push, project_id
mapper.select:
SELECT record.id AS recordId, record.operational_module_type_enum, record.notification_type_enum, record.project_id, user_link.id AS userLinkId, user_link.user_id, user_link.serial_number, user_link.push_time, user_link.content_details FROM sys_push_notification_record record LEFT JOIN sys_push_notification_user_link user_link ON record.id = user_link.sys_push_notification_record_id WHERE record.bool_delete_enum = FALSE
AND record.operational_module_type_enum = #{operationalModuleType}
AND user_link.content_details LIKE CONCAT('%', #{content}, '%')
AND DATE(user_link.push_time) >= DATE(#{startDate})
AND DATE(user_link.push_time) <= DATE(#{endDate})
AND user_link.user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY user_link.push_time DESC
